title: The Ridge, Harker Heights, TX - By Brian E Adams, Realtor with StarPointe Realty
description:
The Ridge is a mid-size luxury neighborhood on the south side of Harker Heights, overlooking Stillhouse Hollow Lake.  The community is across the road from Dana Peak Park, which includes everything you need for Lakeside recreation. The homes are built by Fort Hood’s elite custom home builders like Vale Irvin and Cameo Homes, and are large homes starting at 2000 square feet and over.  Homes in the neighborhood are at different elevations, with those on top of the ridge itself fetching some of the top price points in the entire Fort Hood area and including breathtaking views of the lake on either side of the Ridge. The Ridge is a great option for those looking for an elite home, true contemporary style architecture, and the best views in the Fort Hood area.
